entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metallic plane of the Scars of Mirrodin block, increasingly corrupted by Phyrexia's influence.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The invading force whose contagion and influence spread across Mirrodin.

entities.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
entities.description: A Phyrexian figure on the Phyrexian side of the Plains whose hands resemble those of a Flayer Husk.

entities.name: Mirrodin Vampires
entities.description: Vampires with metallic syringe-like finger spines and metallic blood conduits.

entities.name: Germs
entities.description: Creepy little Phyrexian embryos bound into living weapon artifacts.

entities.name: Pistus flies
entities.description: Mosquito-like insect-things that spread the Phyrexian contagion by feeding on infected hosts.

entities.name: Tyrranax
entities.description: A huge green beast of Mirrodin, one of which lies slain with leaking black ichor.

entities.name: Taj-Nar
entities.description: The capital of leonin culture on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: A city in the Quicksilver Sea occupied by vedalken and Neurok humans.

entities.name: Ish-Sah
entities.description: The hub of the Mephidross and stronghold of Geth.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A forgelike city sacred to Mirran goblins.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: A huge copper tree in the Tangle inscribed with Mirrodin's history.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Holder of the stronghold of Ish-Sah in the Mephidross.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: A region of Mirrodin with Ish-Sah at its hub.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: A people of Mirrodin whose capital is Taj-Nar.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: A people of Mirrodin living in Lumengrid.

entities.name: Viridian elves
entities.description: Elves native to the Tangle of Mirrodin.

events.summary: Phyrexia's influence spreads across Mirrodin, corrupting its landscape between Scars and Besieged.
events.quote: We also asked them to show how Mirrodin's lands have changed as Phyrexia's influence has spread.

relations.quote: The White Sun's Zenith is shown over Taj-Nar, the capital of leonin culture, originally depicted on Ancient Den .

relations.note: Ish-Sah is the stronghold of Geth
